sourceNote: Official Codex system plugins not available in the public openai/plugins repository. Display metadata snapshot only.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Control the Codex in-app browser for local pages and files.

interface.shortDescription: Control the in-app browser with Codex
interface.longDescription: Browser lets Codex open and control the in-app browser, mainly for local development pages and files. Use it to navigate, inspect, click, type, and take screenshots while testing pages inside Codex.

plugins.name: chrome
plugins.description: Control Chrome with Codex using your existing browser state.

interface.longDescription: Chrome lets Codex use your Chrome browser for tasks that need your existing browser state, including open tabs, page content, and websites you're already signed into. It can navigate, view, click, type, and take screenshots while working.

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: Control desktop apps on macOS from Codex through Computer Use.

interface.longDescription: Mac Computer Use lets Codex use apps on your computer, including web browsers and files you allow it to access. You choose which apps Codex can access and can stop actions at any time.

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: Create and edit document artifacts in Codex.

interface.longDescription: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export DOCX document artifacts locally. Use Documents when the durable output or target is a document, Word file, Google Docs document, memo, report, or writing artifact.

plugins.name: presentations
plugins.description: Create and edit presentation slide decks in Codex.

interface.longDescription: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export presentation slide decks locally, including PPTX authoring and Google Slides handoff guidance.

plugins.name: data-analytics
plugins.description: Answer questions with product and business data.

interface.longDescription: Help analysts and business teams answer questions with data. Explore product and business data, explain why key metrics changed, and create reports and dashboards using tools such as Snowflake, Databricks Genie, Hex, and Tableau.

plugins.name: creative-production
plugins.description: Create marketing visuals from a brief.

interface.shortDescription: Create marketing visuals from a brief
interface.longDescription: Help marketing and creative teams turn a brief into assets they can review. Create campaign boards, refine display ad variations, and produce product lifestyle shots or ecommerce-ready image sets with tools such as Figma, Canva, Shutterstock, Picsart, and Fal.

plugins.name: sales
plugins.description: Prepare sales work faster with customer context.

interface.longDescription: Help sales teams bring customer context into work that moves deals forward. Find high-priority accounts and signals, prepare for customer meetings, complete follow-ups, update customer records, build close plans, and review deals at risk.

plugins.name: product-design
plugins.description: Turn early ideas into prototypes teams can review.

interface.longDescription: Turn early ideas into prototypes teams can review. Explore product directions, audit user flows, research user friction, prototype from a live URL, and make static screenshots interactive. Start with a written brief, URL, screenshot, or existing design, then compare visual directions before building.

plugins.name: public-equity-investing
plugins.description: Research public companies and investment theses.

interface.longDescription: Help investors make sense of market data and company information. Review earnings calls and company updates, compare companies, track portfolio signals, and assess whether an investment thesis is strengthening or weakening.

plugins.name: investment-banking
plugins.description: Turn research and diligence into client-ready materials.

interface.longDescription: Help bankers turn research and diligence into customer-ready documents and reports. Prepare pitch materials and investment memos, analyze comparable companies and transactions, and turn diligence into recommendations using trusted data.

plugins.name: spreadsheets
plugins.description: Create and edit spreadsheet files in Codex.

interface.longDescription: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export XLSX, CSV, and TSV spreadsheets locally, including local XLSX authoring for Google Sheets handoff.
